descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our team.
 Required skills: 
Hands-on experience with OpenShift or Kubernetes (OpenShift strongly preferred)
Experience with Git workflows (branching, PRs)
Experience with Argo CD and GitOps principles
Strong Helm skills: writing charts, templating and knowledge of any cloud
Good understanding of Linux, networking (DNS, load balancing, TLS) and containers
Experience with observability tools (Instana, IBM Cloud Monitoring/Logs) is a plus.
 Nice-to-have skills: 
Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
Secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, IBM Secrets Manager, AWS Secrets Manager)
Experience with service mesh, disaster recovery design, or multi-cluster management
Exposure to IBM Cloud toolchains / Tekton is a big plus.
 Hybrid work with 3 days in the office in either Bucharest/Timisoara/Cluj/Brasov 
 Why should you join us? 
We have a solid company (projects that last minimum one year), and employees stay with us on average for about 10 years
We have many projects (50+) and lots of career opportunities. After you finish your first project, for the next one you can choose to master the skills that you already know, or learn new technologies on the next one. This way, you do not have to change the company, just the project
Reimbursement of agreed certifications
Private medical subscription
Team buildings.
